course.title: Unit 7 A Day to Remember【例句】
course.description: Section B What did you learn on that special day?

sentences.content: Do you keep a diary?
sentences.english: Do you keep a diary ?
sentences.chinese: 你有写日记的习惯吗？

sentences.content: Do you think it is a good idea to keep a diary?
sentences.english: Do you think it is a good idea to keep a diary ?
sentences.chinese: 你认为写日记是个好主意吗？

sentences.content: Today we went on a school trip to a farm!
sentences.english: Today we went on a school trip to a farm !
sentences.chinese: 今天我们参加了学校组织的农场郊游！

sentences.content: It was tiring but great fun!
sentences.english: It was tiring but great fun !
sentences.chinese: 虽然很累，但乐趣无穷！

sentences.content: In the morning, we explored the farm.
sentences.english: In the morning , we explored the farm
sentences.chinese: 清晨，我们探索了农场。

sentences.content: There were large tents with tomatoes, cucumbers, and many other fruits and vegetables.
sentences.english: There were large tents with tomatoes , cucumbers , and many other fruits and vegetables
sentences.chinese: 那里有许多大帐篷，里面摆满了西红柿、黄瓜和许多其他水果蔬菜。

wordDetails.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去时态

sentences.content: The farmer told us about how these fruits and vegetables go from the fields to our tables.
sentences.english: The farmer told us about how these fruits and vegetables go from the fields to our tables
sentences.chinese: 那位农民向我们讲述了这些水果和蔬菜是如何从田间地头来到我们的餐桌上的。

sentences.content: I was very interested because I usually only see them in the supermarket.
sentences.english: I was very interested because I usually only see them in the supermarket
sentences.chinese: 我对此非常感兴趣，因为我通常只在超市里见到它们。

sentences.content: Then we got straight to work!
sentences.english: Then we got straight to work !
sentences.chinese: 接着我们立刻投入了工作！

sentences.content: First, we picked some strawberries.
sentences.english: First , we picked some strawberries
sentences.chinese: 首先，我们摘了一些草莓。

sentences.content: The work seemed easy, but it took time to get it right.
sentences.english: The work seemed easy , but it took time to get it right
sentences.chinese: 这项工作看似简单，但要把它做好却需要时间。

sentences.content: Slowly, we filled many baskets.
sentences.english: Slowly , we filled many baskets
sentences.chinese: 慢慢地，我们装满了许多篮子。

sentences.content: In the afternoon, the farmer taught us how to cut branches and leaves from tomato plants.
sentences.english: In the afternoon , the farmer taught us how to cut branches and leaves from tomato plants
sentences.chinese: 下午，农夫教我们如何修剪番茄植株的枝叶。

sentences.content: This helps them to grow more fruit.
sentences.english: This helps them to grow more fruit
sentences.chinese: 这有助于他们种植更多水果。

wordDetails.definition: help（第三人称单数）: 帮助

sentences.content: Finally, we watered the plants.
sentences.english: Finally , we watered the plants
sentences.chinese: 最后，我们给植物浇了水。

sentences.content: Plants need so much work!
sentences.english: Plants need so much work !
sentences.chinese: 照料植物可真费功夫！

sentences.content: It was tiring, but I enjoyed working with my hands.
sentences.english: It was tiring , but I enjoyed working with my hands
sentences.chinese: 虽然很累，但我喜欢动手干活。

sentences.content: One thing I learnt today: Farming isn’t easy!
sentences.english: One thing I learnt today : Farming isn't easy !
sentences.chinese: 今天学到了一件事：种田可不容易！

sentences.content: It made me think of the saying, “Every grain comes from hard work.”
sentences.english: It made me think of the saying ," Every grain comes from hard work ."
sentences.chinese: 这让我想起了那句老话：“谁知盘中餐，粒粒皆辛苦。”

wordDetails.definition: come（第三人称单数）: 来自

sentences.content: The farmer let us take some vegetables home.
sentences.english: The farmer let us take some vegetables home
sentences.chinese: 那位农民让我们带些蔬菜回家。

sentences.content: My mum cooked some for dinner, and they were fresh and delicious!
sentences.english: My mum cooked some for dinner , and they were fresh and delicious !
sentences.chinese: 我妈妈做了一些当晚餐，既新鲜又美味！

wordDetails.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去时

sentences.content: They certainly taste better when you work for them!
sentences.english: They certainly taste better when you work for them !
sentences.chinese: 自己挣来的吃起来才更香！

sentences.content: Today was really a day to remember.
sentences.english: Today was really a day to remember
sentences.chinese: 今天真是令人难忘的一天。

wordDetails.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去时
